lesson.title: A rogue switch on an access port
lesson.goal: Someone plugged a switch into wall port 5. Protect that access port so it shuts instead of forwarding the rogue BPDU.

step.text: Open Closet and run show spanning-tree. UserSwitch is taking part in spanning tree through an access port.
On interface FastEthernet0/5 turn on spanning-tree portfast and spanning-tree bpduguard enable.
Shut the port and open it again. BPDU guard errs the port down instead of forwarding.
Read the reason with show errdisable. Recover later with no shutdown once the rogue switch is gone.

check.label: FastEthernet0/5 is err-disabled by BPDU guard
